resources.string: Could not start sharing. Check the gateway and receiver.
Enable screen receiving in your TV client settings and keep it open.
Android will ask what to share. You can stop at any time from the notification.
Optional app audio requires Android 10 or newer and audio permission. Apps control whether their audio can be shared. The microphone is not captured.
App audio: silence. The app may be silent or may not allow capture.
App audio unavailable. Video sharing continues.
Discovery unavailable. Enter the gateway URL manually.
No gateways found. Check the same LAN or enter the URL.
Select a gateway below, then pair with its code.
Point the camera at the pairing QR on your TV.
Camera unavailable. Go back to pair with a six-digit code.
This mode is not available yet. Screen sharing includes optional app audio on supported phones.
Share your screen with your paired TV. Choose what to share in the Android prompt.
Open Settings → Pair a phone on your TV to get started.
On the TV, open Settings → Pair a phone. Scan its QR or select the gateway and enter the six-digit code.
Confirm %1$s on the TV, then choose Allow.
Pairing declined. Start again from the TV.
Could not reach or pair with this TV. Check the network, refresh or request a new code.
Revoke this phone’s access to the selected TV? Screen sharing must be stopped first.
Each TV approves this phone separately. You can revoke access here or in the TV settings.
Control Zombiebox while the TV app is open. Pairing and system dialogs require the TV remote.
TV is ready for remote control
Open Zombiebox on the paired TV to use the remote.
Last action completed on the TV
Last action was unavailable or expired
Upper limit; your TV, phone encoder or recovery may require a lower resolution.
Uses less bandwidth and more frequent recovery frames. Actual delay depends on the TV and network.
Fix the output frame. Your apps keep their own orientation; unused space appears as black bars.
Fixed framing requires Android 12L or newer to preserve aspect ratio. This phone follows the captured content.
Last 30 sessions on this phone. Format is encoder configuration; audio is its last observed state, not proof of TV playback.
Delete finished sessions from this phone? An active session will be kept.
Your sharing sessions will appear here.
Share permitted audio from other apps. No screen video or microphone is sent. Android will ask for capture permission.
Audio-only sharing requires Android 10 or newer. Remote control remains available on this phone.
App audio unavailable. Audio sharing cannot continue.
Audio permission is required for audio-only sharing.
Sending media files is not available yet. Use Screen for mirroring or Audio to share permitted app audio.
Send an audio or video file to your paired TV.
Select a file using the Android document picker.

MP4, MKV/WebM, MP3, WAV, FLAC or Ogg; up to 256 MiB with a known file size. Keep this screen open during upload (maximum 5 minutes). The gateway checks compatibility before handing off playback. No screen or microphone capture.
Accepted by the gateway. Playback is handed to the paired TV; you can leave this screen. This is not confirmation that the TV has started playing.
Choose a file between 1 byte and 256 MiB with a known size.
Media unavailable. Check pairing, receiver permission, format and gateway space. Reset before retrying.
No document picker is available on this phone.
